devnotes.remarks: Peaceman-Rachford ADI with coefficients frozen at the old state, harmonic face diffusivities and active indices 1..N. Each callback is evaluated once per cell. Optional gravity uses harmonic Ku at internal Y faces, frozen at the old state; outer flux is zero except optional bottom unit-gradient drainage. No circular mask. Failure raises an exception without committing field/diagnostics; reduce the timestep and retry. Nonlinear diffusivity is lagged, not Picard-iterated. This is not a mixed-form Richards solver.
